component.name: Telinhas
component.summary: Manage the mini screens of your PC
Gerencie as mini telas do seu PC

description.p: Telinhas brings together, in one place, the tools to manage the small screens found in PCs: AIO cooler displays, case panels and other mini screens.
This is an early-stage project. For now it supports a single device, the Thermaltake TH360 V3 Ultra ARGB Sync LCD (USB 264a:2348). Support for more devices and features will grow with each update.

ul.li: Show an image on the screen, cropped to its native resolution
Detect when the screen is connected or disconnected

description.p: Planned: more device models and system information on the screen, such as the CPU temperature.
Accessing the screen requires a udev rule on the host; the app shows the command to install it.

screenshot.caption: Screen status, image preview, brightness and rotation

description.p: First public release. Supports the Thermaltake TH360 V3 Ultra LCD: show an image, adjust brightness and rotation. Graphical interface for COSMIC and a command-line tool.
